title: The Last Light of the Harbor
summary: A block-built fishing village living through a full day in 48 seconds.
description: A block-built fishing village by the sea goes through sunset, blue hour and night in a 48 second cycle: a glitter road on the water, windows switching on one by one and a rotating lighthouse beam in the sea haze. Pixel art with atmospheric scattering, volumetric light through a shadow map and Bayer dithering. One self-contained HTML file with three.js; no assets. Built by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in DeepSeek Harness with high reasoning from the same prompt as the other entries in this comparison, then revised over several rounds of feedback with screenshots taken on a real GPU.
